projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: A big-bang rollout for mass producer onboarding was scheduled for October 22, and ALT lists a Watchlist status with the reason that issues during mass onboarding may require rollback and remediation.
riskDescription.condition: Critical defects or integration failures may surface during the mass onboarding event, forcing a production rollback.
riskDescription.consequence: Rollback would disrupt producer access, damage client confidence, and require costly emergency remediation under time pressure.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement phased producer onboarding with staged validation checkpoints to prevent mass rollback scenarios.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon critical defect detection during onboarding, activate rollback procedure and escalate to project board within 24 hours.
risks.reasoning: Open risk documented in ALT as the reason for Watchlist status; big-bang approach concentrates exposure. Limited by missing EMS and Project Artifacts data.

riskDescription.context: File Upload functionality remains inconsistent and requires constant monitoring, as noted in ALT challenges.
riskDescription.condition: Persistent file upload failures may continue in production, affecting producer workflows.
riskDescription.consequence: Producer productivity could decline, support tickets may spike, and client satisfaction may erode.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Implement automated file upload monitoring with alert thresholds to prevent producer workflow disruption.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Activate manual file submission workaround and notify producers immediately when upload failure rate exceeds 10 percent.
risks.reasoning: Carried forward from open ALT challenge; instability persists post-deployment. Single-source signal; impact limited by missing operational metrics.

riskDescription.context: ALT states that development is expected to complete as planned, but there is an inability to assess potential defect volume based on QA coverage to date.
riskDescription.condition: Undetected defects may emerge in production because test coverage was insufficient to reveal them earlier.
riskDescription.consequence: Post-deployment defect volume could exceed support capacity, delaying stabilization and increasing remediation cost.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct comprehensive regression testing with negative test cases before production stabilization to prevent undetected defects.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When post-deployment defect volume exceeds baseline, activate priority triage process and communicate revised stabilization timeline to stakeholders.
risks.reasoning: Open quality risk documented in ALT; uncertainty around defect volume at production entry. Single-source; no EMS or Artifacts data to corroborate or refine.
